name: submit_mfa_reset
description: submit_mfa_reset: Submit a request to change the phone-of-record for MFA. This always returns in_person_required because phone-of-record changes cannot be completed over the phone. A security case is opened to track the required in-person visit.

employee_id.description: The employee requesting the change (e.g. EMP048271).

new_phone_last_four.description: Last 4 digits of the new phone number the caller wants on file (e.g. 9912).
